notes: Gilead paid $11.9B for Kite Pharma — autologous anti-CD19 CAR-T cell therapy Yescarta (axicabtagene ciloleucel) for relapsed/refractory large B-cell lymphoma. FDA-approved Oct 2017 (a few weeks after deal close). Subsequent label expansions into follicular lymphoma and 2L+ LBCL. Peak sales estimate $2.5B reflects Yescarta-specific sell-side consensus across the indications. EV/peak ratio of 4.76× reflects the strategic premium Gilead paid to enter cell therapy + the optionality on the broader Kite pipeline (KITE-585 BCMA, etc.).
selection_rationale: Canonical autologous CD19 CAR-T M&A. Lead asset Yescarta was the first commercial CAR-T product. Anchors the Oncology · cell_therapy cohort with a post-de-risking benchmark.
source: Gilead press release Aug 28 2017; Kite SEC filings; FDA approval letter Oct 18 2017.
